# Billing review — minutes of 12 March 2023

Present: the billing team, collections, and the product owner.

## Invoice numbering

The yearly restart of invoice numbers, decided in the e-mail of 15 March 2021 (requirement 4), is
reversed. From April 2023 invoice numbers follow one continuous sequence with no year prefix,
continuing from the last number of 2022. The new tax authority rules ask for one unbroken sequence
per issuer. This is requirement 9 (REQ-0009), which supersedes requirement 4; card #731 builds it.

## Payment reminders

Payment reminders are no longer sent by registered post. From April 2023 they go by e-mail to the
account's billing address, seven days after the due date. This is requirement 10 (REQ-0010), which
replaces requirement 5; card #744 builds it.

## Next review

The next billing review is in September.
